uncertainty: Base contrasts use 10,000 whole-world bootstrap resamples, seed 981723, and descriptive unadjusted 95% intervals. There are 12 world-level units, not 73 independent observations. These reuse the prespecified worlds from the DeepSeek feasibility design; a provider change does not add independent task worlds. Degenerate intervals do not establish certainty or equivalence. Full-base unscorable bounds are point-estimate bounds, not confidence intervals. Replay agreement on the original pattern-error subset is a conditional diagnostic, not an estimate of error prevalence.
gate_interpretation: All thresholds are fixed practical feasibility rules, not significance thresholds or evidence of a mechanism. Passing permits design review only; no intervention or stage 2 starts automatically. A native-prefix replay is a new generation conditioned on saved text, not restoration of the original hidden state. A versioned model ID does not guarantee an immutable backend implementation.

model_observations.interpretation: An observed returned model string or fingerprint does not guarantee an immutable implementation. Missing fingerprints are not inferred.

cost_estimate.assumptions: Estimated from reported token usage at the recorded published input and output rates. This is not a guaranteed bill, cost cap, or promise of a free quota. Unreported usage, including timed-out requests, can be billable. Account-specific charges or discounts can differ, and rates can change.
